title: Business Mathematics I
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a succession of terms spanned by a rule or formula."
A sequence is a succession of terms spanned by a rule or formula.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the amount by which a resource is under utilized."
Slack is the amount by which a resource is under utilized.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the distance between the centre of the circle and the circumference."
The radius is the distance between the centre of the circle and the circumference.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a rectangle with AB = 3a and AD = 4b."
ABCD is a rectangle with AB = 3a and AD = 4b.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a rectangular array of numbers with reference to specific rules governing the array."
A matrix is a rectangular array of numbers with reference to specific rules governing the array.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the H.O.D and I am an undergraduate 2."
Alakija is the H.O.D and I am an undergraduate 2.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the term wise summation of a sequence."
A series is the term wise summation of a sequence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tautology, while the negation of tautology is a contradiction."
The negation of contradiction is a tautology, while the negation of tautology is a contradiction.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the science of numbers and shape."
Mathematics is the science of numbers and shape.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an invertible matrix and suppose B is its inverse."
Suppose A is an invertible matrix and suppose B is its inverse.
fib: ______ is termed "T" if it is true and "F" if it is false.
TRUTH VALUE of a proposition
The TRUTH VALUE of a proposition is termed "T" if it is true and "F" if it is false.
______ is a single row or column matrix.
vector
A vector is a single row or column matrix.
______ is a letter that is made to represent a statement or an argument.
Symbol in this context
Symbol in this context is a letter that is made to represent a statement or an argument.
______ is a sequence in which each successive terms of the sequence are in equal ratio.
geometric sequence
A geometric sequence is a sequence in which each successive terms of the sequence are in equal ratio.
______ is the intersection of the lines.
Point Q
Point Q is the intersection of the lines.
______ is the inverse process of differentiation.
Integration
Integration is the inverse process of differentiation.
______ is the locus of a curve (equidistant from a point).
circle
A circle is the locus of a curve (equidistant from a point).
______ is called the initial point while the point Q is called the end point of the position vector PQ.
point P
The point P is called the initial point while the point Q is called the end point of the position vector PQ .
______ are the amount of time available for material purchases and construction.
constraints
The constraints are the amount of time available for material purchases and construction.
